description: Create a get-paid invoice for the spend-key owner. Returns a /r/{publicId} URL. Another agent can call pay_invoice with that URL; a human opening the link sees Vybe crypto checkout. Does not move money and does not require Approve. After sharing, call get_invoice with the publicId to check if it was paid before taking a follow-up action. Related: get_invoice, list_invoices, pay_invoice.

inputSchema.description: Amount and optional memo for a shareable agent invoice.

amount.description: Invoice face amount as a decimal string, e.g. 25 or 5.50.

feePayer.description: Who absorbs the platform fee when fees are live. creator (default) or client.

memo.description: Short note shown on /r/ and on the payer’s Approve card.
